mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, original_amount, discount_amount, coupon_id, coupon_name, coupon_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, is_subscribe_unpaid, unpaid_notify_sent, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderNo}, 0, #{payAmount}, #{originalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{couponId}, #{couponName}, #{couponAmount}, #{payType}, #{orderStatus}, #{remark}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{region}, #{detailAddress}, #{shippingType}, #{courier}, #{isSubscribeUnpaid}, #{unpaidNotifySent}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, original_amount, discount_amount, coupon_id, coupon_name, coupon_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, is_subscribe_unpaid, unpaid_notify_sent, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM after_sales a WHERE a.order_id = orders.id AND a.is_deleted = 0) AS after_sale FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id, order_no, pay_amount, order_status, is_subscribe_unpaid, unpaid_notify_sent, created_at FROM orders WHERE order_status = #{status} AND is_subscribe_unpaid = 1 AND unpaid_notify_sent = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 AND created_at <= #{createdBefore} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.order_no, o.is_deleted, o.pay_amount, o.original_amount, o.discount_amount, o.coupon_id, o.coupon_name, o.coupon_amount, o.pay_type, o.order_status, o.remark, o.consignee, o.phone, o.region, o.detail_address, o.shipping_type, o.courier, o.tracking_number, o.sign_status, o.created_at, o.pay_at, o.ship_at, o.confirm_at, o.finish_at, o.updated_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM after_sales a WHERE a.order_id = o.id AND a.is_deleted = 0) AS after_sale FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.is_deleted = 0
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_status = #{status} AND is_deleted = 0 AND created_at <= #{threshold}

SELECT id, user_id, order_no, is_deleted, pay_amount, pay_type, order_status, remark, consignee, phone, region, detail_address, shipping_type, courier, tracking_number, sign_status, created_at, pay_at, ship_at, confirm_at, finish_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_status = #{status} AND is_deleted = 0 AND ship_at <= #{threshold}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND pay_at IS NOT NULL AND pay_at >= #{start} AND pay_at < #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(asi.refund_amount), 0) FROM after_sale_items asi JOIN after_sales a ON a.id = asi.after_sale_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.status = 'refunded' AND asi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.pay_at IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_at >= #{start} AND o.pay_at < #{end}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND pay_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(asi.refund_amount), 0) FROM after_sale_items asi JOIN after_sales a ON a.id = asi.after_sale_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.status = 'refunded' AND asi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.pay_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND pay_at IS NOT NULL AND pay_at >= #{start} AND pay_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date_key

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COALESCE(SUM(asi.refund_amount), 0) AS amount FROM after_sale_items asi JOIN after_sales a ON a.id = asi.after_sale_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.status = 'refunded' AND asi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.pay_at IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_at >= #{start} AND o.pay_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date_key

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.order_id, SUM(asi.refund_amount) AS refund_sum FROM after_sales a JOIN after_sale_items asi ON asi.after_sale_id = a.id AND asi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'refunded' GROUP BY a.order_id ) r ON r.order_id = o.id WHERE o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.pay_at >= #{start} AND o.pay_at < #{end} AND o.order_status <> 6 AND COALESCE(r.refund_sum, 0) < o.pay_amount GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date_key

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date_key

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} AND pay_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date_key

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM after_sale_items asi JOIN after_sales a ON a.id = asi.after_sale_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN orders o ON o.id = a.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.status = 'refunded' AND asi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.pay_at IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_at >= #{start} AND o.pay_at < #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `user` WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date_key
